spec.prompt: Low-angle shot from the water: Lydian cavalry charging through the shallows of the red-brown river of reference image 3, straight toward the camera. The riders are dressed like the man in reference images 1 and 2: open-faced crested bronze helmets, crimson tunics, bronze scale corselets, ochre cloaks, soft boots; they ride chestnut and bay horses on crimson and ochre saddlecloths with bronze bridle fittings, bareback with NO stirrups and no saddles. Each rider holds a long 3-metre ash spear lowered overhand toward the camera. The lead horse is centred; five or six more follow in a staggered line. Hooves explode the water into spray lit gold; the horses gallop in powerful, slightly slowed motion and grow larger in frame, and the lead horse passes just beside the camera at the end. Camera static, low, just above the water. Hard, low golden sun raking in from frame right (the sun itself is outside the frame, beyond the right edge), long shadows, deep black shadows, warm rim light, background much darker than the figures. Clear air: no fog, no haze, no smoke. Photoreal live-action cinema, crisp focus, high shutter speed with no motion blur. Reference images are identity, costume and location references only: never show the grey studio, the turnaround layout or the inset panels. No stirrups, no flags, no modern objects. No text, no watermark.
